verdict.rationale: Otter's homepage makes one thin claim of 'live transcription in multiple languages' (otter-docs-22), which supports multilingual transcription only at a glancing level. Nothing in the pack says which or how many languages are covered, whether summaries are generated in non-English languages, or whether language switching mid-meeting works, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: a documented list or count of supported languages, multilingual summary support, mid-meeting language-switching handling, independent or hands-on evidence of non-English accuracy.
